result_text:
I fixed the typos in the default scoping conventions. The convention tests in `codeanalyzer` pass, but I didn't add tests for the new matches, so the fixes themselves aren't exercised.

**`GeneratedConventions.java`** (in `codeanalyzer/.../sourcecode/scoping/`)
- The pkgdown, Doxygen and meta-generator rules had the extension group `(html|html|xhtml)`, with `html` listed twice. It is now `(html|htm|xhtml)`, so `.htm` pages match too.
- The `// Generated by …` JavaScript rule had the path `.*/[.]js`. It is now `.*[.]js`, so `app.js` matches.
- The .NET `<doc>` XML rule had the path `.*/[.]xml`. It is now `.*[.]xml`, so `MyAssembly.xml` matches.

**`BuildAndDeploymentConventions.java`**
- The Gradle JavaScript rule had the path `.*[.][-]gradle[.]js`. It is now `.*[-]gradle[.]js`, so `build-gradle.js` matches.

The `.html` and `.xhtml` extensions are unchanged, as is `build.gradle`. The content patterns are unchanged too, so hand-written `.htm`, `.js` and `.xml` files only match when they contain the generator markers.
